name: premake
description: Cross-platform build configuration tool that generates project files for multiple IDEs and build systems

premake.description: Build script generator supporting Visual Studio, Xcode, makefiles, and more from Lua configuration scripts
premake.usage:
premake5 vs2022 # Generate Visual Studio 2022 solution
premake5 gmake2 # Generate GNU makefiles
premake5 --help # Show available actions and options
premake5 xcode4 # Generate Xcode project
premake5 clean # Clean generated files
